text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah!
...Not yet... I can still... keep going—!
choice_data_list: (She's pushing herself far too hard—)

text_block_list.text:
She must be running on sheer fumes. Forcing her legs forward through pure willpower,
it looked as though her form was on the verge of breaking down.
choice_data_list: (Just as I thought, what she needs right now is...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You came to watch again♪ Do you have any advice for me?
I'm planning to run one more lap, so even if it's after that—
choice_data_list: You need to rest. You're overworking yourself!
You need to rest. You're overworking yourself!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Aha... Are you a bit forgetful, Trainer?
I told you just the other day... but fine, I'll remind you as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
See, I have to keep moving forward. Pumping my legs, racing my mind,
at a speed no one can ever overtake... forward, forward—and forward!
choice_data_list: —In order to become the Queen.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. Good, so you did remember.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: So with that said, sorry, but I'm getting back to training!
choice_data_list: In that case... that's all the more reason to rest your wings.
In that case... that's all the more reason to rest your wings.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Only by resting your wings can you soar even higher.

text_block_list.text:
Peace of mind brings about peak performance.
It serves as the stepping stone to reaching your ultimate destination.
choice_data_list: I wanted to give this to you.
I wanted to give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
A present for me? Well, as long as it's from the heart,
anything is welcome!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Wait—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is this a discount pass for a reptile café...?! 
I mean, sure, I like them... I love them, actually, but still!
choice_data_list: This shop has a huge variety of reptiles, too.
This shop has a huge variety of reptiles, too.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait a second!
Hold on...!
choice_data_list: It's a hidden gem, so you can spend quality time with each one.

text_block_list.text: I relentlessly push my case with all the research I've gathered—!
choice_data_list: Apparently, you can even interact with rare species!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Urgh…………――

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh my... All right, all right! I surrender!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, right this second.
You're stuck with me now! Naturally, you're coming along too!

Daring Heart accepted the offer to take a break.
I savor the quiet joy of knowing my desperate pitch got through to her.
choice_data_list: You really love reptiles that much, huh?
You really love reptiles that much, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That's not it. ...I've only ever mentioned loving reptiles
in an old magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
To think you actually dug up such an obscure article...
Hehe... I lost to your sheer passion, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow...!　Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look at the glossy sheen on this green iguana's scales...!
It's practically a jewel...! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, this ball python is so gentle, isn't it?
Its skin feels delightfully cool, too... Good boy...! This is the absolute best...!

The moment we arrived at the café, Daring Heart's eyes lit up,
and she went around adoring every reptile in the shop.

As I watch over her, my attention is drawn
to a gecko frozen completely still.
choice_data_list: (Is it asleep... ?)
(Is it asleep... ?)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Did you grow roots?
Don't just freeze up by the entrance, come take a closer look♪
choice_data_list: No thanks... I'll just watch from here!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Don't worry, there's nothing scary about them at all.
Come on! Where's that daring heart of yours?

Bracing myself, I reach out toward a relatively docile-looking frilled lizard—
and the instant I do, its frill flares wide open!
choice_data_list: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're okay... Don't be afraid. Just stay calm and gentle.
I'm sure it'll sense your kind heart...

Calming down, I gently reach out once more,
making sure to convey warmth and friendliness without any hostility...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice... It looks like it really enjoys that.
See? Not so scary after all, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah... it really is cute.
Yeah... it really is cute.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yes... it really is.

After enjoying everything the café has to offer, I check on that gecko
that caught my eye earlier. —Sure enough, it's still completely motionless.
choice_data_list: Has this little guy... been asleep this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's a leopard gecko. Part of it is because they're nocturnal, but...
they also never waste unnecessary movement.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—CHOMP! Nom, nom, nom...
All so they can strike with lightning speed the exact moment they spot prey♪
choice_data_list: I see. Resting is... a way of storing up energy.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: (Storing energy... to unleash explosive power when the crucial moment arrives...?)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ..."The Correlation Between Relaxation and Explosive Top Speed"?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: "By reducing air resistance, eliminating wasted motion, and exploding with energy at the moment of impact. Through this—"

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: "We can expect to compensate for physical handicaps."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Being tense and wound up all the time won't generate maximum spring.
I see, so that's what it means...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...This little one isn't just standing still either.
It's honing its focus. All for the moment that's meant to come.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sharpening your claws constantly won't help you catch the main course.
Ah, that's right... That's it. I need to...—
choice_data_list: ...Did you figure something out?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Thanks to you... I feel like my eyes have been opened!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
You really are... a wonderful Trainer!
And a bit eccentric, too... Hehe, there's never a dull moment with you.
choice_data_list: Could you take a look at this too?
Could you accept this as well?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
What's this? ...A training regimen for the mock race?
And over here... analytical data on Craft and the others, plus a schedule...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Going into this much detail... must have been grueling, right?
Gathering all this materials and analyzing the data must have taken ages...
choice_data_list: Not at all.
Not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: You even looked up the things I like...—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
You summoned your courage and took that step forward for me.
No one has ever gone this far on my behalf... You're the very first.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: You know, I've decided... I'm definitely going to win this mock race.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because thanks to you, I feel like I can fly so much higher.
Far, far higher... than when I was all on my own.
